newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Motor confirms engine deal with Volvo.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Motor confirms engine deal with Volvo.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp confirmed on Friday that it would supply gasoline direct injection (GDI) engines for AB Volvo cars made at their NedCar joint venture.
"Volvo and Mitsubishi agreed over the supply of GDI engines for S40 and V40 cars which Volvo produces at NedCar in the Netherlands," a Mitsubishi spokeswoman said.
She said she could not say how many engines Mitsubishi would supply and when the agreement would take effect because such information could affect Volvo's sales strategies.
Volvo, Mitsubishi Motors and the Dutch government have equal stakes in NedCar, which makes Volvo's S40/V40 series of cars and Mitsubishi's Carisma.
Mitsubishi has said that its GDI engine uses 35 percent less fuel than its predecessor, while reducing carbon dioxide emissions by 35 percent and increasing engine power by 10 percent.
